data.title: About
data.intro: A small neighbourhood café that roasts carefully, bakes at dawn and keeps the lights warm.

children.text: Artisan Café opened on a quiet corner with a lever espresso machine, a second-hand oven and a simple idea: if you take your time with every cup, the day gets a little brighter for everyone who walks in.

We buy green coffee through a small roaster who visits the same farms each harvest. Our house blend is roasted every Tuesday, rested for a week and dialled in fresh each morning before the doors open.

Our bakers start at five. Croissants are laminated over three days, buns are proved slowly overnight and nothing sits on the counter past closing — what is left goes to the community fridge two streets over.
A room to slow down in
Warm wood, soft lamps, plants on every sill and no music louder than conversation. Bring a book, meet a friend or just sit by the window for a while. There is always time for one more cup.

data.title: Private events
data.intro: Book the café after hours for up to thirty guests.

children.text: On weekday evenings the café can be yours: birthday breakfasts that run late, book launches, small workshops or a long table for a team that deserves good coffee.
We offer a coffee bar with one of our baristas, platters of pastries and savoury bakes, and a simple wine and soft-drink list. Menus are planned together with you at least ten days ahead.
Write to us with your date, the number of guests and what you have in mind, and we will reply within two working days.

data.title: House cappuccino
data.summary: Double espresso, silky foam, a dusting of cocoa on request.
data.description: Our everyday cup: a double shot of the house blend under a deep, glossy layer of microfoam, poured in the speckled mugs we fire with a ceramicist down the road.
data.ingredients: House blend espresso (Brazil and Ethiopia), whole milk. Oat or almond milk at no extra cost.

data.title: Flat white
data.summary: Ristretto shots and a thin, velvet pour.
data.description: Two short ristretto shots and steamed milk stretched just enough to stay velvety. Smaller and stronger than a latte.

data.title: Slow latte
data.summary: A gentle, milky cup with a heart on top.
data.description: A long, soft latte made for lingering. Ask for it extra hot, or iced in summer.

data.title: Espresso
data.summary: A short, syrupy shot of the house blend.
data.description: Pulled for 28 seconds on our lever machine. Notes of cocoa, red apple and brown sugar.

data.title: Filter of the week
data.summary: A rotating single origin, brewed by hand.
data.description: Each week we choose one single-origin coffee from our roaster and brew it by hand as a pour-over. Ask the bar what is on today.

data.title: Cold brew
data.summary: Steeped for eighteen hours, served over ice.
data.description: Coarse-ground beans steeped overnight for a mellow, chocolatey cup. Add a splash of milk or tonic.

data.title: Spiced chai latte
data.summary: House-made chai syrup with steamed milk.
data.description: We simmer black tea with cardamom, cinnamon, ginger and clove every morning, then finish it with steamed milk.
data.ingredients: Black tea, spices, raw sugar, milk.

data.title: Hot chocolate
data.summary: Dark chocolate melted into warm milk.
data.description: Seventy per cent dark chocolate, melted slowly and whisked into steamed milk. Rich without being too sweet.
data.ingredients: Dark chocolate, cocoa butter, milk, cane sugar.

data.title: Loose-leaf tea
data.summary: Earl grey, green sencha or chamomile.
data.description: A pot of loose-leaf tea for one, steeped at the right temperature for each leaf.
data.ingredients: Choice of earl grey, sencha or chamomile.

data.title: Cinnamon bun
data.summary: Brown-butter dough, cinnamon sugar, vanilla glaze.
data.description: Our most requested bake. Soft, enriched dough rolled with brown butter and cinnamon sugar, baked until the edges caramelise and finished with a warm vanilla glaze.
data.ingredients: Wheat flour, butter, milk, eggs, brown sugar, cinnamon, vanilla.

data.title: Butter croissant
data.summary: Laminated over three days, shatteringly crisp.
data.description: Made with cultured butter and a three-day lamination for a honeycomb crumb and a crackling, golden shell.
data.ingredients: Wheat flour, cultured butter, milk, sugar, yeast, salt.

data.title: Almond croissant
data.summary: Twice-baked with frangipane and toasted almonds.
data.description: Yesterday's croissants, soaked in light syrup, filled with almond frangipane and baked again under a blanket of flaked almonds.
data.allergens: Contains wheat (gluten), milk, eggs and tree nuts (almond).

data.title: Cardamom knot
data.summary: A twisted bun with freshly ground cardamom.
data.description: Scandinavian-style knot with cardamom ground to order and a crunch of pearl sugar.
data.ingredients: Wheat flour, butter, milk, cardamom, pearl sugar.

data.title: Banana bread
data.summary: A thick slice, toasted with salted butter.
data.description: Made with very ripe bananas and dark muscovado. Served warm with a slice of salted butter.
data.ingredients: Banana, wheat flour, muscovado, eggs, walnuts, butter.
data.allergens: Contains wheat (gluten), eggs, milk and tree nuts (walnut).

data.title: Sourdough toast
data.summary: Thick-cut sourdough, cultured butter, seasonal jam.
data.description: Two slices of our long-fermented sourdough, toasted and served with cultured butter and a jam that changes with the fruit market.
data.ingredients: Sourdough bread, butter, seasonal fruit jam.

data.title: Avocado on rye
data.summary: Smashed avocado, lemon, chilli and herbs.
data.description: Dark rye toast piled with smashed avocado, lemon, chilli flakes, soft herbs and toasted seeds. Add a poached egg for $2.00.
data.ingredients: Rye bread, avocado, lemon, chilli, pumpkin and sunflower seeds.

data.title: Honey granola bowl
data.description: House-baked oat and honey granola with thick yogurt and whatever fruit is poaching on the stove this week.
data.ingredients: Oats, honey, nuts, seeds, yogurt, seasonal fruit.
data.allergens: Contains milk and tree nuts. May contain gluten.

data.title: Artisan Café
data.getting_here: Five minutes on foot from the Larch & 12th tram stop. Bike racks by the front door; street parking is free after 6 pm.
data.seating: Forty seats inside and a sunny bench out front. Step-free entrance and an accessible restroom. Well-behaved dogs welcome.
